purpose: scene-level present/absent decision for the Phase 2 `found` column
threshold_selection: Chosen by a flatness scan across severity strata, NOT the F1-optimal point on the calibration split (0.195). Trades 0.032 of calibration F1 for roughly half the cross-severity variance, because the organizers' severity mix is undisclosed and a threshold tuned to one mix is an unpriced bet.

training_provenance.source: data/dataset derived splits: data/phase2/p2_val and data/phase2/p2_stress
training_provenance.note: Trained only on self-generated Phase 2 validation and stress splits. No organizer-supplied pairs were used in training, in either direction. The held-out p2_test split was never read. Pose features are computed with the same estimated pose used at inference, never ground-truth pose.

measured_performance.caveat: The 51-scene lockbox is small: the CI lower tail (0.838) falls below the 0.85 useful floor, so the F1>=0.90 bonus gate is NOT certified. The point estimate is the best available basis for the operating threshold, and is materially better than the untested constant it replaces.

inference_contract: driftforge/presence_model.py reproduces the training feature vector exactly. A training/inference feature mismatch is silent - the model still returns a plausible probability - so any change to scene_features() must be mirrored in the training script or this model retired.
